status: Approximate isotropic-equivalent bolometric radiated energy; conditional on event belonging to J0754 and assumed blackbody spectra.
geometry: Isotropic equivalent uses 4pi d^2. Standard face-on optically thick flare-patch convention uses projected area pi Rstar^2 and A sigma Tflare^4, giving one quarter of this. Unknown surface orientation changes inferred emitted energy.

central_assumptions.stellar_provenance: Preserved Gaia DR3 astrophysical_parameters FLAME luminosity and GSP-Phot temperature; systematic uncertainty exceeds formal catalogue intervals.

sensitivity_grid: L=30..60 Lsun; Tstar=4500..5250 K; Tflare=8000..12000 K; nine baseline/window combinations. Illustrative systematic envelope, not confidence interval.

integrations.gap_handling: Trapezoid linearly bridges retained-sample gaps, including one ~50-minute gap.

formula: E_iso = ED * Lstar_bol * (Tflare/Tstar)^4 * integral(R Bstar)/integral(R Bflare); E_face_on_patch=E_iso/4
limits: No new image reduction, extinction correction, aperture/PRF throughput correction, neighbour exclusion, or statistical flare-template fit. Assumes relative aperture variation represents whole-star fraction; different flare/stellar aperture throughput and unknown spectral evolution add systematic error. This estimates radiation, not kinetic or total magnetic energy.
